# BeatOS — The MakerLicious (Astro1Deep)

> Open-source local-first sample library browser, Akai MPC / SampQOL OS workstation, and 128-pad (8-bank) beatmaking rack with Cerebro OS DSP rhythmic/spectral Auto-Chop and ES/EN web interface. Developer: Astro1Deep. Repository: https://github.com/Astro1Deep/BeatOS-TheMakerLicious

Important: BeatOS runs on the user's computer and does not install sampler firmware. Hardware export targets differ in native equivalence; WAV/JSON transport bundles are not native hardware backups. Download a release ZIP rather than assuming GitHub's source ZIP is an installer.

## Key workflows & DSP features

- Akai MPC Standalone & SampQOL OS v0.2.0: Drum XPM, Sample/AC50-derived XPJ (1-track or 4-track submix busses), Official MPC Expansion Builder (Expansion.xml + audio previews + .xpansion.zip), and `/mpcqol.conf` safe backup editor.
- Legacy Akai MPC: Binary `.PGM` + 16-bit/44.1 kHz WAV exports for MPC 1000 / 2500 / 500 (JJOS) and MPC 2000 / 2000XL (DOS 8.3 safe names).
- Cerebro OS Master Studio (`/api/cerebro_master_produce`): Unified one-click orchestration combining 3-band PCM spectral analysis, LUFS/Crest headroom & 808 fine-tuning calibration, SampQOL submix routing (`Sub 1–3`), MPCTK chromatic scale bank B deployment, and hardware readiness diagnostics.
- Cerebro OS DSP Acoustic Engine: 3-band PCM spectral timbre analysis, 4/4 / 3/4 / 6/8 / 12/8 / 5/4 meter and Latin Clave detection (Oldies 12/8 Doo-Wop & Lowrider Soul, Bolero, Soul, Jazz, Bossa, Cumbia, Waltz, Drumless, Psych, plus club genres), multi-profile Hip-Hop / Boom Bap / Lo-Fi repitch/stretch adaptation, 3/4 & 12/8 -> 4/4 phrase Auto-Chop with zero-crossing snap, and 808 pitch/phase calibration.
- UI & Accessibility: 9 hardware/ecosystem themes including `Astro1Deep Obsidian`, complete ES/EN backend localization (`beatos_i18n.py`), `:focus-visible` keyboard navigation, and `prefers-reduced-motion` support.
- MPCTK Chromatic Scale Generator: 16-pad chromatic/scale spreading across active rack bank.
- NI Maschine: WAV audio plus JSON mapping, not native MXGRP.
- Roland SP-404MKII: WAV 16-bit/48 kHz import files; Roland SP-404A/SX: 12-pad WAV 16-bit/44.1 kHz.
- Teenage Engineering PO-33 / PO-133: Mono audio sampling reel (44.1 kHz) and local FSK backup archive verification.
- Teenage Engineering EP-133 K.O. II: WAV/ZIP transport and mapping, not a native project backup.

This document is an optional factual pointer for machine-readable discovery. It does not guarantee that any particular search engine or AI system will crawl or use it.
